title: MSc Machine Learning
about: KTH's two-year (120 ECTS) MSc Machine Learning, taught in English, for studies starting autumn 2027. Applications through University Admissions are due 15 January; documents and fees by 1 February; results on 1 April.
requirements: Apply through University Admissions in Sweden (up to four ranked programmes)
Documents and any application fee due 1 February 2027

field "Machine learning" (Master's applicants) → objective "Unsupervised learning: clustering (k-means, DBSCAN), dimensionality reduction (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP)"
